stem: Which answer choice best describes the x-coordinate in an ordered pair?

options.label: F
options.text: The horizontal line composed of the set of points that all have a y-coordinate of 0

options.label: G
options.text: The first number in an ordered pair that determines the movement left or right from the origin on a coordinate grid

options.label: H
options.text: The second number in an ordered pair that determines the movement up or down from the origin on a coordinate grid

options.label: J
options.text: The intersection of two lines on a coordinate grid
